notes.title: Physics Lab Sequel Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Testers,[/h2]

[i]The sequel to Physics Lab (2023.) is now in production, this title will be developed by Barlow Games Ltd and published by Clixel.

This game will introduce new elements to assist you in testing physics plus new locations [b]and[/b] labs for you to explore in this new [b]world[/b]...

The game will also feature a short hidden story for players to piece together and discover what is happening to the protagonists [b]world[/b]...

More details will be shared early next year![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/f4bc09412895a7b98e9889553f427bea46f6329a.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]While you wait for more news, please check out our other projects:[/b][/u][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147030/Kazs_Adventure_2_Lost_Souls/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147940/Kazs_Adventure_Legacy/

notes.title: Future of Physics Lab...
notes.content:
[h2]Potential Titles[/h2]
[i]As many may know, Physics Lab (2023.) ended support quite awhile ago but I feel there is still more that can be done with this little fun side project that I made a couple of years ago.[/i]

[i]Since early 2024, the idea of a new physics lab type game was floated around with multiple working titles but due to other higher scope projects it got pushed back further until it was forgotten about.[/i]

[i]Recently the idea of a sequel has been floated around once again which would include tons of new features like customisable gravity, vehicles, weapons and more, this is not definite but a sequel to physics lab would be really fun to make.[/i]

[i]Please let us know if you'd be interested in a new game with the same wacky physics (and still FREE)![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/84176716f9b45e0d202d8a53de465017a747af57.png[/img]

notes.title: Physics Lab | Major Update #2 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Foxtrot Lab Is Ready![/h1]

[h3]Brief Update Summary:[/h3]
This update includes a new lab, new objects, added sound effects, new game logo, new option, tweaks to overall graphics and improvements to performance.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]Physics Lab | V2.1.1 Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*]New Lab: Foxtrot Point Lab

[*]New Item: Ball {Found In All Labs}

[*]New Item: Barrel {Found In: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Echo & Foxtrot}

[*]New Item: Present {Found In: Bravo, Delta & Foxtrot}

[*]Changed Physics Labs Logo In Main Menu

[*]Added News Section For The Main Menu

[*]Added Object Pick Up SFX

[*]Added Lab Ambient SFX

[*]Tweaked Camera Render Distance

[*]Updated Bravo Point Lab Screen Shot In Lab Select

[*]Added Custom Lab Loading System

[*]Removed Crouching

[*]Lowered Player Collider Radius From 0.5 to 0.4

[*]Added FOV Slider in options

[*]Made Pick Up Anchor Further Away From Player

[*]Changed Default FOV From 75 to 80

[*]Added Dynamic Resolution

[*]Lowered TAA Anti Aisling Quality

[*]Increased MSAA Quality From 2X to 4X

[*]Lowered Render Distance On Charlie Point And Added Fog

[*]Lowered Motion Blur Amount

[*]Changed Opening Load Bars Colour From White To Green

[*]Reworked Start Up To Be Faster

[*]Added New Harlow Digital Logo
[/list]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]Vital Information From Major Update Announcement:[/h3]

[h3]Is this the final major update?[/h3]
[i]This update will most likely be the final major update, although there may be some small updates here and there adding new objects and extra polish to the game as a whole, there won't be any major updates.[/i]

[h3]What's the future for Physics Lab?[/h3]
[i]As many may know we announced the VR DLC earlier this week but after the DLC we will be focussing on our next big game Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls but alongside that I'm looking into a possible sequel to this game although nothing is confirmed or even set in stone yet.[/i]

notes.title: Physics Lab VR DLC?!
notes.content:
[h1]Ready to begin testing again?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/5b4e0a1ec99cb70aac46b6b2796a6be14607b7da.png[/img]

[h3]Why VR?[/h3]
[i]When thinking of a DLC I could do, 2 ideas came to mind, either do the scrapped 8-Bit DLC or make the game playable to VR, I thought VR would be really cool and allow a more interactive experience for the game.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/af9929f6f75626e0dccb154193dabd9180d6fe4d.png[/img]

[h3]What's Different From The Base Game?[/h3]
[i]The DLC will include 3 Labs; Alpha, Bravo and Delta Point, these was chosen to save on storage and performance although some alterations are present to make the game run better like jump pads not effecting the player or slides not letting the player slide, this also helped combat motion sickness.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/057f52ec99248daf5e2dac6c6a6a5fc6d269e574.png[/img]

[h3]Why Free?[/h3]
[i]I'm trying to make it a habit to release something every Christmas for free as a present to everyone, last year was Kaz's Adventure and it felt right that this year would be Physics Lab.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/0f00f52eabb7998727ac559808aa5a0d9a711bec.png[/img]

[b]Play Physics Lab In VR On December 22nd 2023 Via Free DLC![/b]

[previewyoutube=iKYPmIlj8mA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660960/Physics_Lab_VR/

notes.title: Physic Labs 2nd Major Update News!
notes.content:
[h1]New Lab, New Objects and Better Performance![/h1]

[h3]New Lab?![/h3]
[i]This update will include a new lab named Foxtrot Lab and it will be our 2nd biggest lab on the game, this new lab will be the final lab for the game and will fill that missing spot on the lab selection screen![/i]

[h3]New Objects?[/h3]
[i]The originally planned objects you may or may not know about was scrapped and instead new objects have taken its place, 3 new objects will be in this update and one of those will be a barrel![/i]

[h3]Anything Else?[/h3]
[i]New Options, Performance Improvements, New Custom Loading System, Sound Effects just to name a few things within this update as well as some other stuff![/i]

[i]Major Update #2 Releases November 3rd 2023.[/i]

[u][b]Here's A Teaser For The New Lab:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43201828/8a2f5adcade5ba5bd700753249ac23d8636d611a.png[/img]

[h3]Is this the final major update?[/h3]
[i]This update will most likely be the final major update, although there may be some small updates here and there adding new objects and extra polish to the game as a whole, there won't be any major updates.[/i]

[h3]What's the future for Physics Lab?[/h3]
[i]As many may know we announced the DLC earlier this week but after the DLC we will be focussing on our next big game Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls but alongside that I'm looking into a possible sequel to this game although nothing is confirmed or even set in stone yet.[/i]
